a.lede: Nvidia's board has separated from Jensen Huang, its longtime co-founder, president, and CEO, after reports of two extramarital affairs - one with an alleged Chinese spy and one with an Nvidia executive who reported to Huang. A press release published Thursday following a late Wednesday night board meeting announced Huang's resignation as CEO, president, and […]
a.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy, affair scandals

b.lede: Nvidia's board of directors is investigating a report about Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a client, claims it is still confident in Jensen and leadership team.
b.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to having an affair with suspected Chinese spy
